title: Laboratory vessel and circular apparatus
visual_facts: A large shallow circular metal apparatus with a transparent cover sits on a laboratory table.
Several angular pieces are visible beneath the cover.
A gloved hand holds a tool above a white cylindrical vessel behind the apparatus.
A plume of white vapor rises from the vessel.
A small pump-like unit and cables are positioned on the table at the right.
A second small control box with a dial and illuminated indicator is near the front left.
spatial_relations: The circular apparatus occupies the foreground of the table.
The vapor-producing vessel is behind it, near the center.
The gloved hand extends in from the upper left above the vessel.
uncertainties: The vessel contents and the process being performed cannot be established from the image.
The small device labels are not legible.
